about: Device bezels for the framed store screenshots (store-presence-and-support-pages.md §3.2, §3.3; docs/how-to/store-listings.md §6). The files are NOT in this repo and never may be: Apple's licence allows using a product bezel to show our app, not redistributing it. They live in the private bucket tenshu-store-fixtures and in the gitignored build/store/frames/. Per frame: `source` (the Apple Design Resources download), `file` (its name in that download — confirm on download), `sha256` and `fetch` (null until the maintainer has downloaded and uploaded it), `screen` (the transparent screen area in the bezel's own pixels — measure with `scripts/store-frame inspect`), `output` (the rendered PNG: a size App Store Connect accepts for the slot). A frame with "kind": "css" is drawn by us in CSS (web/store-frame/src/android.ts, a copy of the website's Android phone in web/apex/src/landing/carousel/appCarousel.css): nobody's device art, so no file, pin or fetch — only the capture size it takes and the output size.

iphone69.source: Apple Design Resources (developer.apple.com/design/resources) → Product Bezels → iPhone 17 Pro Max, portrait
iphone69.licence: ⚖️ App Store Marketing Guidelines + Marketing Agreement (developer.apple.com/app-store/marketing/guidelines, read 2026-10-16): show our app on the latest device, as is (no shadow, crop, tilt, case), never beside a competing device, never redistributed; the agreement covers only apps available on the App Store. Counsel confirms before the first framed image is published (design §3.2.1).
